name: Structural Connectome MRTrix3 (SCMRT) (SIFT2)
summary: Builds SIFT2-weighted structural connectivity matrices (count, density, length and mean diffusion measures) from a tractogram, CSD FODs, 5TT mask and volumetric parcellation with MRtrix3 and outputs conmat and networkneuro datatypes.
description: Computes per-streamline SIFT2 weights with tcksift2 (anatomically constrained by the 5TT image) and uses them in tck2connectome to build symmetric count, density, length and density-of-length matrices, plus mean-microstructure matrices when tensor, NODDI or spherical-mean maps are given. It also builds a networkneuro datatype with parcel surfaces. The tractogram, FODs, 5TT image and parcellation must be in the same space.

inputs.description: Volumetric parcellation with label.json; each label becomes a network node.
inputs.requirements: Must be in the same space as the tractogram.

inputs.description: Constrained spherical deconvolution FODs; the lmax given by the lmax parameter is used by SIFT2.
Five-tissue-type (5TT) image used for anatomically constrained SIFT2.
inputs.requirements: Must be aligned with the tractogram and FODs.

inputs.description: Optional DTI/DKI maps (FA, MD, RD, AD and kurtosis maps if present); used to build mean-microstructure matrices.
Optional NODDI maps (NDI, ODI, ISOVF); used to build mean-microstructure matrices.
Optional spherical-mean map; used to build a mean-microstructure matrix.

outputs.description: All connectivity matrices as CSV files (count, density, length, density-of-length and per-measure mean matrices).
Connectivity matrix datatype (csv/correlation.csv with label.json) of streamline counts between node pairs.
Connectivity matrix datatype (csv/correlation.csv with label.json) of mean streamline length between node pairs.
Connectivity matrix datatype (csv/correlation.csv with label.json) of streamline counts scaled by inverse node volume.
Connectivity matrix datatype (csv/correlation.csv with label.json) of length-scaled counts normalised by inverse node volume.
networkneuro datatype for brainlife visualisation: matrices, per-edge streamline lists and parcel surfaces.

parameters.description: Spherical harmonic order of the CSD FOD image used by tcksift2.
